usageNote: 口语短语！表示「还没搞定/还在迷茫中」，比如项目卡壳了就用这个，超生动！

examples.en: We're not out of the woods yet — the project still has major issues.
examples.zh: 我们还没脱困——项目还有大问题。

examples.en: After months of treatment, the doctor said she's finally out of the woods.
examples.zh: 经过几个月的治疗，医生说她终于脱离危险了。
